General a,b rely on formal case decomposition, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: Counting idempotents by rank is a structural invariant of a natural full monoid. Proper double-star trees are the first diameter-three trees with two independently branching hubs, where cross-bridge assignment creates a genuine interaction absent from the solved single-star family. The full exact polynomial across all a,b, not a narrow table, supports later work on regular J-classes and idempotent-generated structure without claiming those downstream theorems.
